source: task 1D001C12, review 20261127171102, consolidated finding (adversarial and code-quality)
summary: `crew-task.py ship` is the one command that ships a task: commit, merge the base, re-run the tests, push, open a draft PR, mark the task DONE. It is idempotent: after a stop the owner fixes the cause and runs `ship` again, and it continues from the first step that no longer holds, re-checking the earlier ones.
defect: The `pr` step holds whenever a URL was recorded: if the owner closed that PR (or it was merged) before the re-run, `ship` reports "pr already done" and marks the task DONE against a closed PR instead of opening a new one.
